column3: The log journal source is now produced (W5a P-log, SharpitLogHandler): one event per WARN-or-above record with BootUI LogPayload fields (logger, level, template, exceptionClass); the kind itself is not implemented; deviations: records below WARNING are not offered (BootUI RuntimeJournalLogAppender records WARN and above only); WARNING is level WARN and CRITICAL is ERROR; template is LogRecord.msg unformatted, masked and cut at 500 (an object gives its class name, never its str()); envelope executionId and threadKind absent; marks not carried; exceptionClass from exc_info (the exception's class when set); requestId only for this install's requests; sharpit's own loggers and internal work are skipped (BootUI skips its own loggers); produced only while the log-tail or exceptions panel is enabled (the log handler is installed for those panels only, as BootUI's journal appender is installed with the journal); the template is masked as the log tail's message is, so a secret-looking word in a template can mask what follows it, and METADATA_ONLY withholds it (null)
The log journal source (level, requestId) is now produced; the kind itself is not implemented
